blocks.description: Watches 1 to n background processes. It fires OnPoll every IntervalSeconds while any process is queued or running (not while the browser tab is hidden): refresh your data action there. OnFinished fires once when the last one ends.

inputs.description: Reloads the page after ReloadSeconds when all processes finished without errors.

inputs.description: Shows a Refresh button when all processes finished.

inputs.description: True: Refresh reloads the page after OnRefresh. False: only OnRefresh fires.

children.value: If(Total = 0, "Nothing to watch yet", Done + " of " + Total + " finished" + If(Running > 0, ", " + Running + " running", "") + If(Failed > 0, ", " + Failed + " failed", ""))

If(If(Processes.Current.StartedOn = NullDate(), -1, DiffSeconds(Processes.Current.StartedOn, If(Processes.Current.FinishedOn = NullDate(), CurrDateTime(), Processes.Current.FinishedOn))) < 0, "", If(If(Processes.Current.StartedOn = NullDate(), -1, DiffSeconds(Processes.Current.StartedOn, If(Processes.Current.FinishedOn = NullDate(), CurrDateTime(), Processes.Current.FinishedOn))) < 60, If(Processes.Current.StartedOn = NullDate(), -1, DiffSeconds(Processes.Current.StartedOn, If(Processes.Current.FinishedOn = NullDate(), CurrDateTime(), Processes.Current.FinishedOn))) + " s", If(Processes.Current.StartedOn = NullDate(), -1, DiffSeconds(Processes.Current.StartedOn, If(Processes.Current.FinishedOn = NullDate(), CurrDateTime(), Processes.Current.FinishedOn))) / 60 + " min " + Mod(If(Processes.Current.StartedOn = NullDate(), -1, DiffSeconds(Processes.Current.StartedOn, If(Processes.Current.FinishedOn = NullDate(), CurrDateTime(), Processes.Current.FinishedOn))), 60) + " s"))
If(Failed = 0, "All " + Total + " finished.", Failed + " of " + Total + " failed.")

events.name: OnPoll
events.description: Refresh the data action that fills Processes.

events.name: OnRefresh
events.description: When set, Refresh fires this instead of reloading the page.

attributes.description: What the user sees, for example Import statements.

attributes.name: Status
attributes.description: queued, running, completed, failed or cancelled.

attributes.name: Progress
attributes.description: 0 to 100, or -1 when unknown (an animated bar).

attributes.name: Message
attributes.description: A short status line or the error message.
